The CRUD Data Lifecycle

C.R.U.D. Process Flow

C

1. CREATE

Initiates the data lifecycle by generating and storing new records in the database.

R

2. READ

Retrieves and displays existing data records based on specified criteria.

U

3. UPDATE

Modifies existing records, often targeting a specific entity by its identifier.

D

4. DELETE

Removes records permanently from the persistent storage system.

CRUD Mapping Overview (SQL & HTTP)

Operation SQL Equivalent HTTP Method
Create INSERT POST
Read SELECT GET
Update UPDATE PUT / PATCH
Delete DELETE DELETE
